description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'LanguageTranslationController' within the OrangeHRM project. It handles the pre-render logic for language translation editing, including retrieving language data and setting up Vue.js components with relevant properties.

classes.name: LanguageTranslationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing language translation edit view, fetching language data, and configuring Vue component with language properties.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data for the language translation editing view. Checks for 'languageId' in the request, retrieves language info, verifies its status, and sets up the Vue component with relevant properties.
